data.gender_notes: Maazin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azaana', meaning to support, assist or help. In Islamic contexts, Maazin may be associated with Allah's infinite mercy and assistance. The name Maazin carries the meaning “A helper, supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maazin usually hope their child will grow to embody a helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maazin total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
